outlet: 'Vote Yes on Rural EMS' neighbors' letter, linked by KOZE Sept. 16, 2026
notes: Supporters' letter: levy funds the County-City of Lewiston ALS paramedic contract, which expires Dec. 31, 2026; without the levy EMS would cease Jan. 1, 2027; Life Flight limits; town halls with Lewiston Fire and Asotin County Fire District #1.
